newsitem.title: USA: Broward Cty, Fla., mulls $800 mln school bond plan.
newsitem.headline: Broward Cty, Fla., mulls $800 mln school bond plan.

text.p: Florida's Broward County School Board will ask voters to approve as much as $800 million of general obligation bonds for school construction, Miami Herald reported Tuesday.
Board Chairman Abe Fischler said the vote could come as early as June or as late as November.
Proponents filed election papers Monday to create a campaign account for Friends of Children and Education, a political action committee that will lobby for the bonds.

The district, which encompasses Fort Lauderdale, estimates it has $1.4 billion of construction needs through 2002. In September of 1995, Broward County voters rejected a sales tax hike to fund school construction.
